name: – Dimitris Tsiodras, Piotr Müller – Article 2, before § 1 – Am 116
title: REPORT on the proposal for a regulation of the European Parliament and of the Council amending Regulations (EC) No 1272/2008, (EC) No 1223/2009 and (EU) 2019/1009 as regards simplification of certain requirements and procedures for chemical products
part_text: (1 a) In Article 14, in paragraph 1, the following point is added: (ea) intentionally added per- and polyfluoroalkyl substances (PFAS) that contains at least one fully fluorinated methyl (CF3-) or methylene (-CF2-) carbon atom (without any H/Cl/Br/I attached to it).
